title: Nexus ExecutionProjection
description: Shared durable execution projection (A2/A7): recovery class, current human wait, stable reason code and the legal operator actions. Present for schedules without a run (version/revision null, class from policy).

execution_version.description: Durable execution version; null when no run exists.

state_revision.description: Durable state revision; null when no run exists.

wait.description: Current durable A4 human wait, if any.

reason_code.description: Stable machine reason code for uncertain/terminal outcomes.

allowed_actions.description: Legal operator actions in the current durable state.
